Tomas finished his rounds and walked slowly down to the wet shingle. A green bottle lay in the weed. He dried the glass and worked the cork loose with a knife. The paper was brittle and brown. It was written in pencil by a child who named a harbour and a date. The date was forty years past. Tomas read the note twice and copied the address onto clean paper. He wrote a reply that evening. The supply boat took the letter ashore on Thursday with the old bottle. Weeks passed without any answer. Then a card came from the harbour, signed by a woman aged fifty. The card is kept in the lamp room.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市很静。路灯照着空无一人的街道，信号灯在路口按时变换颜色。环卫工人开始清扫人行道，扫帚的声音很轻。面包店亮起灯，师傅正在揉面。出租车偶尔驶过，车灯扫过紧闭的店门。天空仍然是黑的，东边还没有光。地铁首班车将在一个半小时后发车。", "w03": "• Recursion means solving a job by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n• Each copy passes a smaller piece down until the piece is so small that the answer is obvious.\n• Then the answers are passed back up and combined into one final answer."}
